summary: Federal grain inspector with roughly a decade of combined experience across grain grading, industrial process operations, and electrical installation in industrial and plant settings. Currently performs grain sample testing for moisture, test weight, dockage, foreign material, and specialized aflatoxin and protein analysis, with calibration of equipment and official certification. Background includes monitoring process equipment, temperature and flow control for boilers and furnaces, and installing and calibrating motors, switchboards, relays, and pumps. Holds an Associate of Science in Process Technology and multiple industrial safety credentials including OSHA, HSE, fall protection, water survival, and first aid/CPR.
